A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose an unsupervised domain adaptation method using a transformer framework.
we design a cross-domain transformer for unsupervised domain adaptation (CDTrans) to learn accurate feature representation and align the source and target domains for the challenging URA task.

, in contrast with the existing UDA methods which focus on learning domain invariant features using CNNs, we adopt Transformer to perform UDA, which achieves state-of-the-art performance in various UDA benchmarks, and is robust to the noise of pseudo labels in target samples.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Transformer is a strong backbone to tackle the challenging UDA problems, which is not only robust to the noisy labels but also can achieve competitive performance on the standard benchmark datasets.
the cross-attentive mechanism in Transformer is robust enough to align the source/target features even if the pseudo labels for target domain are not perfect.
